item.title: Week 10: Steelers at Bengals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: CIN -3.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CIN 59% vs. market 66% | On paper, Cincinnati has the edge, led by its 1st-of-32 EPA per dropback (+0.33), though Pittsburgh counters with the top broken-tackle rate (7.4%) against a Cincinnati defense ranked 24th (11.1% missed). Joe Burrow ranks 1st of 31 in EPA per dropback while Aaron Rodgers ranks 27th of 31, and Pittsburgh's x-factor is Jaylen Warren, who gains +2.1 rushing yards over expected per carry, 1st of 34, against a Cincinnati run defense ranked 26th. The model gives Cincinnati a 59% win probability, led by Starting QB (+3.8 points) and Passing matchup (+3.4 points).
